name: ralt-ondc-monorepo
description: RALT ONDC Logistics Service Provider (BPP) & Delivery Partner Fleet Monorepo

scripts.build: pnpm --filter '@ralt-ondc/*' build || npm --prefix services/ondc-lsp-service run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/ondc-lsp-service test && npm --prefix apps/delivery-app test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix services/ondc-lsp-service run test:coverage && npm --prefix apps/delivery-app run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix services/ondc-lsp-service run lint && npm --prefix apps/delivery-app run lint
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run scan && npm run test:coverage
